subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve state on npm metadata failures

question: Should this focused lifecycle-owned patch be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106189, or should its behavior be consolidated into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106436?
rationale: Both open branches are viable and overlap heavily, but the competing branch adds a sibling update-check parser change whose inclusion is an ownership and scope choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Land this focused branch
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical state-preservation fix, refresh it on current main, and close the overlapping PR after merge unless its extra parser change is independently needed.

options.title: Consolidate into the broader branch
options.body: Move any stronger proof or focused tests from this PR into the competing branch if maintainers want its additional update-check parser behavior in the same fix.

recommendation.title: Land this focused branch
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical state-preservation fix, refresh it on current main, and close the overlapping PR after merge unless its extra parser change is independently needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the installer, updater, tests, and user-facing plugin update documentation needed to choose the canonical boundary.
